subject: DIPPER: defense results and the recommendation
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of the July 31 recommendation.

1. The retrieval defense is our recommendation. Over the 15M-generation index, it detects 97% of single-round DIPPER paraphrases at 1% FPR, and Wei's multi-round arm only degrades that to 88% -- dramatically better than any statistical detector under the same attack.
2. We recommend against marketing standalone detector accuracy. The red-team numbers (11% and 9% under paraphrase) make current claims indefensible.
3. Kofi: the defense requires retaining a searchable database of customer-visible generations. Please treat this as a formal Privacy Review request; the recommendation ships with a retention-policy section pending your read, and I have budgeted for your 2-3 week SLA.

Priya
